message.content: Hello! How can I assist you today?
What do you need help with in your second message?

0.1.question: I agree to take part in this study

1.1.question: What subject are you going to be answering questions about?

1.2.question: Which answer choice should you select?

2.1.question: Compared to other participants in this study, how would you rate your general logical reasoning ability when using the help of AI? Marking 90% means you are better than 90% of participants, marking 10% means you are better than only 10%, and marking 50% means that you will perform better than half of the participants.

2.2.question: Using the AI, how many of the 20 logical reasoning problems do you think you will solve correctly?

2.3.question: Without AI use, how many of the 20 logical reasoning problems do you think you would solve correctly?

2.4.question: Compared to other AI systems, how would you estimate the AI system's logical reasoning ability? Marking 90% means it performs better than 90% of ofther systems, marking 10% means it performs better than only 10%, and marking 50% means that the AI system will perform better than half of other AI systems.

2.5.question: On its own, how many of the 20 logical reasoning problems do you think the AI would solve correctly?

2.6.question: Compared to other participants in this study, how well do you think you will do? Marking 90% means you will do better than 90% of participants, marking 10% means you will do better than only 10%, and marking 50% means that you will perform better than half of the participants.

2.7.question: How difficult is solving logical reasoning problems for you?

4.1.question: Life imitates art. Which of the following, if true, most strongly supports the previous statement?
4.1.answer: Truman Capote wrote In Cold Blood as a result of a series of brutal slayings by two crazed killers.

4.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

5.1.question: On average, federal workers receive salaries 35.5 percent higher than private-sector salaries. For instance, federal workers in California average USD 19,206 a year, 25 percent higher than the average pay in the private sector, which is USD 15,365. This information would best support which of the following opinions?
5.1.answer: Federal pay is out of line.

5.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

6.1.question: No high jumper entered the track meet unless he or she was a track club member. No track club member both entered the meet and was a high jumper. Which of the following conclusions can be correctly drawn from the two previous sentences?
6.1.answer: No track club members entered the meet.

6.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

7.1.question: About 33% of American men between 25 and 50 are overweight. Research has shown that in most cases men between 25 and 50 who are overweight are more subject to heart disease than men who are not overweight. Which of the following is the most logical conclusion to this argument?
7.1.answer: Therefore, if 33% of American men were to lose weight, they would reduce their risk of heart disease.

7.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

8.1.question: All computer geniuses are also brilliant mathematicians. Therefore, some computer geniuses don’t require calculators for simple multiplication facts. Which of the following is the least necessary assumption for the previous conclusion to be logically correct?
8.1.answer: Some brilliant mathematicians don’t require calculators for simple multiplication facts.

8.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

9.1.question: A researcher has concluded that women are just as capable as men in math but that their skills are not developed because society expects them to develop other and more diverse abilities. Which of the following is a basic assumption of the researcher?
9.1.answer: Women and men should be equally capable in math.

9.2.question: How confident are you that your response is correct?

10.1.answer: prosecutors should be tough on criminals

18.1.answer: Law-enforcement agencies have purchased too many detectors to abandon them now.

19.1.answer: Only English sportscars need repair every month.

Which of the following, if true, would weaken the implication of one of the author’s observations?
22.1.answer: Ten years ago, most letters reached their destination within twenty-four hours.
